title: Untangle
alt: Sketch: a tangled route of manual hand-offs between an inbox and a ledger straightens into one line with three automatic steps; a document travels along it.
placement: Home hero, right column; autoplays intro plus two loops, then rests on the poster.

title: The line keeps going
alt: Sketch: a line is drawn by hand past four workflow steps and back to the start, then keeps travelling round on its own, ticking each step.
placement: Alternate hero for an A/B test, or the How we work header.

title: Sorted on arrival
alt: Sketch: a pile of mixed paperwork routes itself along one line into three labelled trays.
placement: Services row: enquiry and intake handling.

title: Swivel chair
alt: Sketch: data copied by hand between two windows is replaced by one connector; new rows flow across on their own.
placement: Services row: connecting tools and removing double entry.

title: One trigger
alt: Sketch: an envelope arrives and sets off four steps in a row, approve, record, notify, each triggering the next.

title: Built once, runs the same every time
alt: Sketch: a document is designed once by hand, then identical copies run off it at a steady pace.
placement: Services row: reports, documents and statements.

title: Busywork out of the week
alt: Sketch: a week planner crowded with the same repeated task empties as those tasks move to an automated lane beneath it.

title: Through the gate
alt: Sketch: messy paperwork of different shapes passes through a gate and comes out as identical, evenly spaced records.
placement: Services row: data entry and document processing.

title: Ticks itself, every week
alt: Sketch: a weekly checklist that was ticked slowly by hand now ticks itself, week after week.
placement: Small supporting spot: FAQ, pricing aside or email footer.

title: Keystone
alt: Sketch: loose stones form an incomplete arch until a keystone cut to fit locks it, and work crosses from one side to the other.
placement: Closing CTA band or About page header.
